experiment.name: hf_patchtst_revin_no_volume
experiment.description: HF PatchTSTModel + RevIN, raw OHLC target, volume dropped entirely (input + target). Step 4 of the experiment ladder -- same-notebook rerun of the earlier volume-free RevIN result, to confirm (with identical code/infra to step 3's two volume-included runs) that dropping volume restores above-chance directional accuracy.
